brand.name: RECSOUTUBE
brand.tagline: Une expérience vidéo épurée, rapide et indépendante
brand.concept: Modern, distraction-free video streaming web application powered by Invidious API with a distinct editorial-cinematic visual identity. Not a YouTube clone.
brand.emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro & Cinematic Studio (Deep Obsidian + Electric Flare Accent)

layout.structure: Fixed top glass header + collapsible responsive left navigation sidebar + main scrollable content stage with asymmetric grid
layout.sidebar_width: w-64 (desktop expanded), w-20 (desktop collapsed/icon view), slide-over drawer (mobile)
layout.bento_grid_video: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-5 lg:gap-6
layout.watch_page_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 (Player & Metadata: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 | Recommended Sidebar: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4)

video_card.style: Aspect-video thumbnail container with rounded-2xl overflow-hidden, smooth zoom-on-hover scale-105 transition duration-300, glass duration badge on bottom right, high density title & channel info with avatar
video_card.badge_duration: absolute bottom-2 right-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono font-medium bg-black/80 text-white backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10

custom_player.wrapper: relative w-full aspect-video rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 shadow-2xl bg-black group
custom_player.controls_overlay: absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/95 via-black/60 to-transparent p-4 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 flex flex-col gap-2 backdrop-blur-sm
custom_player.progress_bar: w-full h-1.5 hover:h-2.5 bg-white/20 rounded-full cursor-pointer relative transition-all

header_search.input: w-full pl-10 pr-12 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-surface-elevated border border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 text-sm transition-all shadow-inner
header_search.search_icon: absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground w-4 h-4

sidebar_nav.item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold border border-primary/20 shadow-sm
sidebar_nav.item_inactive: flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-elevated transition-colors font-medium text-sm

states_and_ux.skeleton_loader: Animated subtle shimmer pulsing cards with matching rounded-2xl aspect-video thumbnails and line blocks
states_and_ux.empty_states: Iconography + clean French copy + primary button action for history/subscriptions/playlists
states_and_ux.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for user actions (video saved to playlist, instance changed, link copied)
states_and_ux.animations: Framer motion page fade-ins, gentle hover lifts on video cards, micro-interactions on play/like buttons

testing_and_attributes.rule: Every button, link, search input, filter tab, video card, player control, theme toggle, and key metric MUST include data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Frontend uses React JavaScript (.js / .jsx), not TypeScript. Keep code in .js/.jsx syntax.

Implement Invidious API integration layer with fallback instances (e.g., invidious.nerdvpn.de, inv.tux.pizza, vid.puffyan.us, or public API wrapper) with custom mock fallback data if instances are unreachable.
Maintain high contrast in both Dark and Light themes. Avoid low-contrast text on dark backgrounds.
Ensure total responsiveness from mobile (<640px) to ultra-wide displays.
Do NOT copy YouTube styling directly; use RECSOUTUBE's signature rounded-2xl cards, dark studio surface styling, glowing primary accent borders, and glassmorphic top header.
